title: 2.5.19 Reject the Bad Input
description: Throw an error when a password is too short, and catch it with a clear message. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Set up the password
steps.instructions: Create a constant called password set to "abc".

steps.title: Check the length and throw
steps.instructions: Inside a try block, if password.length is less than 8, throw new Error with a message saying the password must be at least 8 characters. Otherwise log "Password accepted".

steps.title: Catch and report
steps.instructions: In the catch block, log err.message. Test with "abc", then change password to a longer value and confirm it logs "Password accepted" instead.

requirements.title: throws a new Error
requirements.description: Code throws a new Error when the password is too short
